# from template(passacaglia, @eccl3_season, ground=<[g1 ~ ~ ~ d2 ~ ~ ~] [a#1 ~ ~ ~ c2 ~ ~ ~]>): a passacaglia at 100 in G minor, the phrase sung over it (templates v1)
# phrase: @eccl3_season, "To every thing there is a season" (King James Bible, Ecclesiastes 3:1 (first clause), The translators of the King James Version, 1611)
# vocal: 9 syllables, iambic, straight feel, stress ~x~x~~~x~: a vocal line of 2 bars, sung over sections of 8 bars
# ground: <[g1 ~ ~ ~ d2 ~ ~ ~] [a#1 ~ ~ ~ c2 ~ ~ ~]>; the bass line under every section, never changed
# upper: the form's own line in G minor, upper; the line above the ground, changed a little more every pass
tempo 100
key gm
swing 0.08

# the drums: the drm_* parts are what the arrangement changes; the kick and the shaker stay put
let kick4 = x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~
let drm_clap = ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~
let drm_hat = ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~
let shk = x ~ x x ~ x x ~
# ground, bound: <[g1 ~ ~ ~ d2 ~ ~ ~] [a#1 ~ ~ ~ c2 ~ ~ ~]>
let ostinato_1 = g1 ~ ~ ~ d2 ~ ~ ~
let ostinato_2 = a#1 ~ ~ ~ c2 ~ ~ ~
let ostinato = <ostinato_1 ostinato_2>
# what the variations are made of: the chords, and a line above the ground that every pass changes a little more
let chords_1 = [g3, bb3, d4] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [eb3, g3, bb3] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~
let chords_2 = [c3, eb3, g3] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [d3, f#3, a3] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~
let chords = <chords_1 chords_2>
let upper_1 = g4 ~ bb4 d5 ~ bb4 g4 ~ d4 ~ g4 bb4 ~ g4 d4 ~
let upper_2 = eb4 ~ g4 bb4 ~ g4 eb4 ~ c4 ~ eb4 g4 ~ d4 f#4 ~
let upper = <upper_1 upper_2>
# the vocal line: a degree of the key for each syllable, ! on the stressed ones
let vox_a = ~ 2 1! 4 5! 7 4 2
let vox_b = 1! 1 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~

# ground: the ostinato and the chords alone
section ground 8 bars {
  deck A: kick kick4 kit=drums vel=80..95 | bass ostinato inst=bass vel=75..90
  deck B: harmony chords inst=strings vel=40..55 len=8
}

# variation: the line above the ground, and the drums
section variation 8 bars {
  master: reverb 0.15
  deck A: kick kick4 kit=drums vel=85..100 | clap drm_clap kit=drums vel=60..80 | hihat drm_hat kit=drums vel=45..70 | bass ostinato inst=bass vel=75..90
  deck B: harmony chords inst=strings vel=40..55 len=8 | arp upper inst=marimba vel=50..75
}

# sung: the phrase over the ground, the line under it
section sung 8 bars {
  master: reverb 0.15
  deck A: kick kick4 kit=drums vel=80..95 | hihat shk kit=drums vel=30..45 | bass ostinato inst=bass vel=70..85
  deck B: harmony chords inst=warm-pad vel=30..42 len=8 | arp upper inst=kalimba vel=30..45 | melody <vox_a vox_b> inst=kalimba oct=3 vel=24..38
  deck B: sing "to /eh v r ee/ thing there is a /s ee z uh n/" on melody voice=robot-choir
}

# cumulative variations: each ~ stays and the next is added on top of it; the ground is never touched
arrange {
  ground
  variation
  ~ upper_* rot 2 | accent 0.25
  ~ drm_hat thin 0.15
  sung
  ~ upper_* rev | drift 0.1
  ~ drm_* grow
  variation
  @ vox_* xfer shk
  sung
  ~ upper_* up 1
  variation
  ~ upper_* down 1
  ~ drm_* decay
  sung
} loop 3 then end
